item.title: Water Table Chemistry and Maintenance (KOH Routine)
item.description: My low-cost water table routine (softened house water plus a little potassium hydroxide), why it works, what the blue and green additives are and cost, the aluminum/hydrogen procedure, pH checks, and dumping and refilling in San Diego.
